text:
jess: Heads-up — PR #4829 is ready for security review. It's the auth + secrets flow for the on-prem agent: envelope encryption with KMS, add a `lockbox` sidecar to proxy secrets, and update VPC egress whitelist. @alex can you take a look?

alex: On it. Quick Q: does this change token formats or rotation flow?

jess: No format changes. Rotation still uses the same versioned secret path. I added a small migration script and a masking test. Example run: ```bash
./scripts/migrate-secrets.sh staging
```

chao: glanced through code — minor test nits but nothing blocking. Bigger item: on-prem agent will open outbound 443 to our KMS endpoints; we'll need an explicit egress firewall exception (and to document allowed IPs). tagging infra.

marta: infra here — we can do a NAT-based allowlist. Prefer restricting to KMS IP ranges + our NAT IPs. Also need confirmation that no plaintext creds are logged anywhere.

jess: Confirmed we redact any secret-like fields in logs and added unit test `test_log_masks_secrets`. We'll use NAT IPs for allowlist. Target deploy window is tomorrow 02:00 UTC but flexible.

alex: I ran `terraform plan` in staging against the branch — no provider/block drift. From security side, I'm OK to sign off pending: 1) infra egress rule is in place, and 2) explicit KMS key policy review. :eyes:

marta: We'll whitelist three NAT IPs (will post them in the ticket). Please drop the PR link + a ticket for the KMS policy so infra can review. Assign to me.

jess: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4829. Created INF-998 to track KMS key policy review and infra allowlist. Added a short checklist to the PR body: egress rule, key policy, CI green, rotate test secrets post-merge.

alex: Approved from security side. Leaving formal review comment on the PR. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z for commit abc123 (PR #4829).

chao: I'll merge once infra confirms the allowlist and CI passes. Reminder: rotate test secrets after merge and before prod rollout.

jess: Thanks everyone — holding merge until INF-998 is closed and infra confirms. Will ping here when everything is green.
